far.meaning: Gross floor area of all buildings on a premises divided by total premises area, with express component rules.

front_property_line.meaning: Street-adjoining line selected under §113.0246, including corner and double-fronted rules.

lot.meaning: Legally established parcel, tract, or area of land under SDMC §113.0237; APN identity alone is insufficient.

lot_area.meaning: Area bounded by Code-determined property lines; public right-of-way treatment follows §113.0246.

lot_depth.meaning: Straight-line distance from midpoint of front property line to midpoint of rear property line.

lot_width.meaning: Perpendicular distance between side lot lines at the midpoint of the front-to-rear depth line.

premises.meaning: Land and structures with unity of use constituting the smallest conveyable unit.

rear_property_line.meaning: Line opposite and most distant from the front line under the Code classification rules.

side_property_line.meaning: Property line connecting front and rear lines and not selected as a front line.

street_frontage.meaning: Length of premises property line along the street it borders.

street_side_property_line.meaning: Side property line abutting public right-of-way; alley adjacency does not create one.

structure_edge.meaning: Setback comparison uses the qualifying structure/building feature and projection rules, not an undifferentiated footprint.

structure_height.meaning: Measured at plumb lines to the lower of existing or proposed grade and subject to overall, topographic, roof, parapet, and appurtenance rules.

policy: Definitions are authoritative measurement semantics, separate from table values and project facts.
